correctness.rationale: W=AD^-1 has spectrum [-1,1] via reversible similarity, so det(I-αW)>0 for 0<α<1. Tree determinant equals matching polynomial, adjugate and Neumann recurrence yield exact numerator coefficients. Exhaustive NetworkX nonisomorphic-tree representatives 1,1,2,3,6,11,23,47,106,235 for n2..11 tested with exact Fractions; interval Descartes sign variation <=1 for every pair n<=10. For n11 exactly 30 pairs are Descartes candidates; independent symbolic exact root counting after removing forced endpoint factors leaves exactly 3 actual two-crossing pairs, one automorphism orbit (3,10),(4,10),(5,10) in one tree. Witness F(α)=3α^6+4α^5-18α^4-16α^3+26α²+12α-12 has exactly two interval roots by sign samples/Descartes. Fresh independent n2..11 census and exact witness rational evaluations reproduced all counts; any roots at 0 or1 were excluded.

value.rationale: Sharp graph-order boundary for double PageRank ranking reversals and unique witness classification is a motivated exact structural invariant showing limits of damping robustness on the simplest connected graphs. Full finite census is meaningful, not an arbitrary small example.

final_claim: In uniform-teleportation PageRank of unweighted connected undirected trees, no vertex pair reverses strict score ranking twice for n<=10; at n11 a single tree/pair isomorphism orbit achieves two reversals with exact polynomial witness.
limitations: Unweighted undirected trees, uniform teleportation only; not directed, Katz, weighted, personalized PageRank.
